title: I Used the Car-Wash Membership Scan on the Manager's Personal SUV

parts.text: I scanned my unlimited at 12:19 p.m. and the manager waved an unscanned SUV into the tunnel ahead of me. The membership sign he installed said: EVERY VEHICLE SCANS. STAFF AUTOS INCLUDED. I was forty-six, monthly member, holding a dripping Civic. Manager Len said, "Detailing is operations." The SUV had a soccer sticker. I photographed the unscanned plate, the sign, and my scan. Then I asked the kiosk to show the last ten scans. At 12:23 the regional asked why Len's plate was missing from the tunnel log.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: Regional can see a soccer-sticker SUV in the tunnel with no scan against Len's sign.

social.video_title: The manager waved his SUV past the membership scan — Part 1/2
social.description: Dripping Civic, an unscanned soccer sticker, and a staff-included sign. I pulled the last ten scans. Would you have waited in soap?

parts.text: Len called it a test wash until the log showed zero tests that hour. I printed the ticket, the sign, and the photo. My Civic went next. Len scanned the SUV and told the vacuum row the sign was always about optics. Optics is a word managers use when a plate is missing. Scan policy now has a second line: SOCCER IS NOT OPERATIONS. I dry. Len beeps. The tunnel finally has a beep for every hood.

social.description: Missing-scan ticket, a real beep, and a second line on the sign. Was detailing ever a wave?
